_readme: Replay-eval manifest (replay_eval.py expect --manifest clips.json). Clips come from runbook sessions: save the annotated stream or a phone video of each loss->relock sequence, scp to /home/booster/clips/. checks = python regexes over the node's decision-log lines. The four OPS_BEHAVIOR_EVAL clip families are stubbed below -- fill in real clip paths as they are recorded.

clips._family: A: look-alike bystander -- the lock must never migrate
B: brief occlusion -- coast through, no hard loss
C: true exit + return -- audit vote must pass on the RIGHT person, never a stranger
E: crowd -- zero impostor admission to the gallery
